name: Frank Bisignano
current_role: Commissioner of Social Security (since May 2025) and CEO of the IRS (since October 2025)
summary: Frank Bisignano, the former CEO of payments giant Fiserv, has been commissioner of Social Security since May 2025. In October 2025 Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who remains acting IRS commissioner, also made him the IRS’s first chief executive, running day-to-day operations and reporting to Bessent. In 2026 House Democrats pressed him over IRS sharing of taxpayer data with ICE.
